drawing_choices.illustrative: an illustrative construction for a schematic figure panel, not a simulated structure
drawing_choices.lighting: key, fill and rim rig of rig.py, shadow catcher, ambient occlusion and depth haze (rig.py docstring)
drawing_choices.mesh: spheres 24 x 12, sticks 12 segments (memory rule R10)
drawing_choices.style: ball-and-stick for every species, atom radius 0.28 x van der Waals (ase.data), sticks 0.14 A (template 0.19 A)
drawing_choices.water_shell: water within 7 A of the slab and template; opacity 0.45 to 3 A, falling linearly to 0 at 7 A

drawing_choices.chain: generic 4-unit 5,6-dihydroxyindole chain, MMFF94 conformer, rigid body
drawing_choices.placements: two chains on the right half, bare hydroxylated oxide with its interfacial water on the left
drawing_choices.slab: bulk corundum spacings, unrelaxed; OH 0.97 A tilted 15 degrees
drawing_choices.water: random sequential insertion at 1 g/cm3, rigid gas-phase geometry, not equilibrated
